real_world_source.name: UCI501 Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality licensed original recorded 12 stations, non-synthetic

protocol.scope: EXPLORATORY 2x2 factorial descriptive mechanism study with all eight fresh models. DOES NOT MEET strict FAIR architecture comparison because measured supported-op FLOPs max 62,072,899 / min 61,376,965 gap 1.121% > 1%; full AdamW FLOPs not independently verified. Do not claim architectural superiority.
protocol.independent_axes: head count 2 or4; key widths8 or4 with 256 persistent FP32 matrix cells in both; hard top-half write routing versus soft differentiable all-head writing; read router always soft
protocol.state: all arms identical source-limited state fast80+slow80+16x16 matrix+16 x80 source slots=1696 FP32 scalars and16 Boolean occupancy flags=6800 nominal bytes
protocol.weights: 4head trained+deployed 99747,2head 99261, pair gap0.487%, no dummy/frozen parameter padding, all live FP32 trained modules
protocol.train: Two prespecified distinct seeds 40401/40402, SAME original sampled station-hour ID order and training schedule across ALL FOUR arms within each seed; exactly 128 AdamW steps ×8 cases per arm. Each source case 24 historical genuine observed hourly readings, FIT period March2013-Aug2014, +6 original measured target only after model prediction. Sequential fits do not share trained weights, optimizer or RNG between arms.
protocol.loss: identical in all arms: 0.8 genuine observed-only masked standardized Gaussian NLL +0.2 absolute error +0.25 same-source sensor-distinct weighted per-head key collision hinge abs cosine>.85 +0.03 soft probability head-balance penalty; no future-label-derived key targets. Fixed before any fit. No stochastic head sampler, learned log temperature clamped [-0.693147,0.693147].
protocol.optim: AdamW learning_rate0.0005,weight_decay0.001,grad_norm_clip1.0, no warm start/pretrained weights, no hyperparameter selection or additional tries based on out-of-time metrics
protocol.source: Original source SHA256 pinned exact UCI501 original ZIP; chronological station IDs and actually observed 13 channels masks + elapsed since observation + causal last-seen; future query 6D time-of-day/week/year known calendar, NOT control action, do() or physical weather values; normalization from training FIT original measured coordinates only
protocol.timecuts: training before 2014-09-01; chronological 2014-09 to Dec validation using original fixed station-hour every336 hours; previously-exposed DEV 2015 numerical loaded only after ALL eight checkpoint original byte hashes frozen; 2016-2017 original numeric protected rows NEVER parsed
protocol.evidence: Preserve all 8 original full weights/optimizer/RNG/FIT normalization/sampler SHA/entire training loss trace, 2014 validation and 2015 DEV original prediction arrays and scores; independent clean Git checkout reload original checkpoints and bit-exact array/score replay without optimizer
protocol.metrics: All-channel normalized MAE and Gaussian NLL, pooled90 coverage and per-channel risk, raw PM2.5 MAE vs unmatched practical persistence. All eight outcomes, mean by two seeds, no cherry picking. Model-comparison results purely DESCRIPTIVE due unmet strict 1% complete compute criterion and reused exposed 2015 development.
protocol.stop: Exactly 8 trained models and 1024 total optimizer updates. Fail closed on source hash, data order, nonfinite/partial gradients, model/state shape, unexpected parameter count, source leak, checkpoint replay mismatch, protected-data access. No retries or tuner iterations under this registration; preserve failures and create new registration only after independent justification.
protocol.scientific_boundary: Cannot claim Mamba/Transformer language intelligence, associative recall correctness, causal action policy, qualified calibrated probability or mathematically proven entire FP32/AD graph. Local operator math separate PNDS.
protocol.audit: Model remains in own isolated draft branch, LATFUSE002+003 original checkpoints and results unmodified; external independent reward/outcome/source rights attestation still inconclusive. Synthetic only for unit tests.
